package courseplannotification

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Handler struct {
	Teachers TeacherEnsurer
	Store    repository.CoursePlanNotificationStore
	Dialogs  repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
	Clock    Clock
}

// Handle owns a Teacher-originated result before attempting idempotent Dialog
// delivery. Student- and system-originated requests have no Teacher notification.
func (handler Handler) Handle(ctx context.Context, raw domain.CoursePlanOutcome) (bool, error) {
	outcome, err := domain.NormalizeCoursePlanOutcome(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if outcome.Source != domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher {
		return false, nil
	}
	// Planner v2's learning_path_id is accepted for compatibility but is not
	// yet part of Teacher's notification schema. Drop it before persistence so
	// the v1 inbox remains the complete replay/deduplication contract.
	outcome.LearningPathID = ""
	if handler.Teachers == nil || handler.Store == nil || handler.Dialogs == nil || handler.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("course plan notification dependencies are required")
	}
	teacher, err := handler.Teachers.Execute(ctx, outcome.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	notification, created, err := handler.Store.Accept(ctx, domain.CoursePlanNotification{
		Outcome: outcome, PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, Body: notificationBody(teacher.Language, outcome),
		AcceptedAt: handler.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if notification.DeliveredAt != nil {
		return created, nil
	}
	if outcome.AuditRefs.DialogID == "" {
		return created, nil
	}
	binding, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: outcome.AuditRefs.DialogID, StudentID: outcome.StudentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: notification.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	message, err := handler.Dialogs.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, outcome.EventID, notification.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if err := handler.Store.MarkDelivered(ctx, outcome.EventID, message.ID, handler.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return created, nil
}

func notificationBody(language string, outcome domain.CoursePlanOutcome) string {
	english := strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(language)), "en")
	if outcome.Status == domain.CoursePlanStatusFailed {
		if english {
			return "I couldn't prepare the updated learning plan yet. Your current path is unchanged; please try the planning request again later."
		}
		return "Пока не удалось подготовить обновлённый учебный план. Текущий маршрут не изменён; попробуй повторить запрос позже."
	}
	if outcome.CourseID == "" {
		if english {
			return "The learning plan is ready. No new course is needed for the requested outcome right now."
		}
		return "Учебный план готов. Для выбранного результата новый курс сейчас не требуется."
	}
	if english {
		return "The learning plan is ready. The course has been assigned and the first available lesson is in your learning path."
	}
	return "Учебный план готов. Курс назначен, а первый доступный урок добавлен в твой learning path."
}
